title: Quantum field theory I
prerequisites: G4, P4, P5, M8a, M8b; G2 recommended.
purpose: Quantize free fields and calculate elementary perturbative amplitudes with explicit conventions and checks.

blocks.deliverable: Derive a field equation and conserved current.
Compute commutators and a free two point function.
Check a spinor solution and its conserved current.
Week 7 midterm; expand an interaction picture evolution operator.
Translate a simple interaction into diagrams.
Compute a leading observable and check dimensions.
Present a checked calculation and take a QFT I exam.

project: Derive a lowest order scalar scattering amplitude and track normalization and symmetry factors.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
